question: How should Travel OS discover worthwhile local food and reduce tourist-trap/hype risk, with optional Maps support?
strongest_countercase: Obscure venues often have sparse evidence, while famous venues may deliver excellent meals. Strong corroboration requirements can reproduce popularity bias. Preserve promising low-evidence leads separately and do not use tourist presence, menu language or review counts as automatic verdicts.
unknowns: The proposed method has not been shown to improve actual meal outcomes; source heuristics are largely practitioner experience.
No live Maps call, host compatibility, account-specific terms, cost estimate or provider data-retention implementation was tested.
No real Marrakech shortlist or dietary/meal brief was executed; those belong to the proposed pilot.

objective_assessments.reason: Multiple practitioners plus primary evidence on review limitations support a bounded proposed method. Historical evidence and heuristics do not certify individual venues.
Official documentation supports a conditional integration choice, with incomplete review access and retention/host checks explicitly unresolved for installation.
Proposal fits existing skill ownership, user preferences and request scope. Behavioral and real-meal evaluation are future acceptance checks, not claimed outcomes.

sufficiency.reason: Source attributions are supported; combined workflow and tool preference remain a proposed judgment, not a validated algorithm or installed service.
